name: Kondou Isami
source:
The founder, head principal & Kendo coach of Hakuou academy, He has an easygoing personality and is kind, thoughtful & very passionate about the well being of his students, however he seems to have a bad habit of training in the halls. He lives in a deserted dojo as his home.

[From [url=http://hakuouki.wikia.com/wiki/Hakuouki_SSL]Hakuouki Wiki[/url]]
